title: Where a Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Lands After a Missed Recovery
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — the tier a missed-recovery review sets.**

**1.** At a missed-recovery review the plan returns to Paystride Access Starter.

**2.** The tiers rank upward from Paystride Access Starter through Paystride Access Standard, Paystride Access Plus, Paystride Access Preferred and Paystride Access Premier to Paystride Access Premier Plus; a tier named as one or two below the current tier never goes below Paystride Access Starter.

**3.** At a missed-recovery review the plan never moves up, and it lands where the review's protections place it. Each protection names the highest tier it lets the plan keep; a protection lets the plan keep only Paystride Access Starter unless one of its own tiers names a higher tier for the plan; the plan lands on the lowest of those tiers and never higher than one tier below its current tier, and when the tier carries a write-off reset and the plan's latest write-off was booked on or after its level effective date and on or before the payday reviewed it lands on Paystride Access Starter whatever the protections allow. This replaces, for every payday that carries a shortfall, the former rule of moving down by the tier's downgrade steps; at a review of a payday that carries no shortfall the write-off return applies as the tier review states.

**4.** A write-off counts at the review of the first payday on or after the day it is booked, a write-off booked on a payday always standing before that payday's review is recorded: one booked after the payday reviewed is taken at the review of the plan's next payday, never at the review recorded for the payday before it, and while such a write-off is the plan's latest the review takes no earlier write-off either, the next payday's review returning the plan to Paystride Access Starter for both. This replaces, for every review under the missed-recovery review, the former rule that a write-off returns the plan to Paystride Access Starter at the next level review.

## Hypothetical cases

| Tier held | Latest write-off | Landing |
|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Preferred | booked between the level effective date and the payday reviewed | Paystride Access Starter |
| Paystride Access Standard | none | Paystride Access Starter (one tier below Paystride Access Standard is Paystride Access Starter) |
| Paystride Access Starter | none | Paystride Access Starter (no tier lies below it) |
| Paystride Access Premier | booked the day after the payday reviewed | the write-off is not taken at this review; it is taken at the review of the plan's next payday |
